title: What If Earth Stopped Spinning For One Second?

scenes.narration: Right now, you're spinning at about a thousand miles an hour. You just can't feel it.
scenes.image_prompt: POV standing on a city street, motion lines showing Earth's rotation, calm people, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Now imagine the Earth stops. Instantly. But you don't.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of everything frozen for a split second, clocks stopped, birds mid-air, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Everything not bolted down keeps moving east. People, cars, oceans. At the speed of a jet.
scenes.image_prompt: POV of a massive ocean wave rising over a coastline, cars sliding sideways, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16
